```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

plot_metabolite_clinical_bipartite_pdf <- function(
    gsutil_cmd = "gsutil",
        permutations = 1000,
    repo_local_dir = NULL,
    trait_annotation_path,
    pdf_output_path
) {
  # --- 1. Load required libraries ---
  required_libs <- c(
    "dplyr", "ggplot2", "tidyverse", "glue", "readxl",
    "MotrpacHumanPreSuspension", "MotrpacHumanPreSuspensionData",
    "openxlsx", "PMA", "ComplexHeatmap", "circlize", "RColorBrewer", "tibble","tidyr","igraph","ggraph","grid","grDevices")
  missing_libs <- required_libs[!sapply(required_libs, requireNamespace, quietly = TRUE)]
  if (length(missing_libs) > 0) {
    stop(paste0("Missing packages: ", paste(missing_libs, collapse = ", "),
                ". Please install them first."))
  }
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(lapply(required_libs, library, character.only = TRUE))
  
  plot_dir  <- dirname(pdf_output_path)
  
  if (!dir.exists(plot_dir)) {
    dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    message(glue::glue("📂 Created Plot output directory: {plot_dir}"))
  }
  
  # --- 2. Load clinical data ---
  anthro_dataset <- MotrpacHumanPreSuspensionData::cln_curated_anthropometrics_vitals[["data"]] %>%
    filter(visit_code == "ADU_SCP")
  exercise_dataset <- MotrpacHumanPreSuspensionData::cln_curated_ex_performance_testing[["data"]] %>%
    filter(visit_code == "ADU_SCP")
  key_dataset <- MotrpacHumanPreSuspensionData::cln_raw_key[["data"]]
  
  clinical_data <- key_dataset %>%
    merge(anthro_dataset, by = "pid") %>%
    merge(exercise_dataset, by = c("pid", "visit_code")) %>%
    mutate(
      sex = case_when(
        sex_psca == 1 ~ "Female",
        sex_psca == 2 ~ "Male",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      age = age_psca
    )
  
  # --- 3. Load metabolomics omes data ---
  omes_data <- MotrpacHumanPreSuspensionData::load_qc(
    selected_tissues = "blood",
    selected_omes = "all",
    epigen = FALSE,
    gsutil = gsutil_cmd,
    repo_local_dir = repo_local_dir,
    load_acute_only = TRUE,
    remove_unnamed_metab = TRUE,
    remove_redundant_metab = TRUE,
    verbose = TRUE
  )
  
  # Combine metabolomics sample metadata and qc_norm
  metab_keys <- names(omes_data[["blood"]])
  metab_keys <- metab_keys[grepl("^metab", metab_keys)]
  sample_metadata_list <- lapply(metab_keys, function(k) omes_data[["blood"]][[k]][["sample_metadata"]])
  qc_norm_list <- lapply(metab_keys, function(k) omes_data[["blood"]][[k]][["qc_norm"]])
  
  metabolomics_sample_metadata <- dplyr::bind_rows(sample_metadata_list)
  metabolomics_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(qc_norm_list)
  
  metabolomics_sample_metadata <- metabolomics_sample_metadata %>%
    filter(Timepoint == "pre_exercise") %>%
    dplyr::select(vialLabel, pid, randomGroupCode)
  
  metabolomics_vial_labels <- metabolomics_sample_metadata$vialLabel
  metabolomics_subset <- metabolomics_data[, colnames(metabolomics_data) %in% metabolomics_vial_labels]
  metabolomics_subset <- metabolomics_subset[, order(match(colnames(metabolomics_subset), metabolomics_vial_labels))]
  
  metabolomics_bids <- setNames(metabolomics_sample_metadata$pid, metabolomics_sample_metadata$vialLabel)
  colnames(metabolomics_subset) <- metabolomics_bids[colnames(metabolomics_subset)]
  
  metabolomics_pids <- unique(gsub("\\..*", "", colnames(metabolomics_subset)))
  
  # --- 4. Prepare clinical subset ---
  clinical_subset <- clinical_data %>%
    dplyr::select(pid, bmi, peaktorqavg_iske, avg_handgrip, wtkg_cpet, wattend_cpet, hrend_cpet,
                  sysend_cpet, diaend_cpet, sysrecv1_cpet, diarecv1_cpet, hrrecv1_cpet,
                  avg_vecart_cpet, avg_vco2cart_cpet, avg_rercart_cpet,
                  VO2max, VO2max_L, O2_pulse, age) %>%
    filter(complete.cases(VO2max)) %>%
    filter(complete.cases(.))
  
  colnames(metabolomics_subset) <- make.unique(colnames(metabolomics_subset)) 
  
  # Step 2: Convert the wide format into a long format
  metabolomics_long <- metabolomics_subset %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "metabolite")  %>%
    mutate(metabolite = gsub("\\.\\.\\.[0-9]+$", "", metabolite)) %>%
    distinct(metabolite, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -metabolite,
      names_to = "pid",
      values_to = "value"
    )%>%
    mutate(original_pid = gsub("\\..*", "", pid)) %>%
    dplyr::select(-pid) %>%
    dplyr::rename(pid = original_pid) %>%
    filter(complete.cases(.))
  
  # Step 3: Coalesce data for each unique PID
  metabolomics_coalesced <- metabolomics_long %>%
    group_by(metabolite, pid) %>%
    summarize(
      value = dplyr::first(na.omit(value)),  # Take the first non-NA value for each group
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Step 4: Convert back to wide format
  metabolomics_wide <- metabolomics_coalesced %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = pid,
      values_from = value
    ) %>%
    column_to_rownames("metabolite")
  
  metabolomics_wide <- metabolomics_wide[, colSums(is.na(metabolomics_wide)) == 0]
  
  metabolomics_subset = metabolomics_wide
  
  # --- 5. Align datasets ---
  common_bids <- intersect(colnames(metabolomics_subset), clinical_subset$pid)
  metabolomics_final <- metabolomics_subset[, common_bids]
  
  metabolomics_final <- as.data.frame(t(apply(metabolomics_final, 1, function(row) {
    row[is.na(row)] <- mean(row, na.rm = TRUE)
    row
  })))
  
  clinical_final <- clinical_subset[match(common_bids, clinical_subset$pid), ]
  clinical_final <- clinical_final %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::remove_rownames() %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "pid")
  
  metabolomics_final <- t(metabolomics_final)
  clinical_final <- as.matrix(clinical_final)
  
  # --- 6. CCA analysis ---
  set.seed(123)
  
  invisible(capture.output(
  permute_result <- PMA::CCA.permute(metabolomics_final, clinical_final,
                                     typex = "standard", typez = "standard", nperms = permutations)
  ))
  
  cca_result <- PMA::CCA(metabolomics_final, clinical_final,
                         typex = "standard", typez = "standard",
                         penaltyx = permute_result$bestpenaltyx,
                         penaltyz = permute_result$bestpenaltyz,
                         K = 3)
  
  # --- 7. Prepare heatmap data ---
  metabolite_variate <- cca_result$u  # metabolite canonical variates
  clinical_variate <- cca_result$v    # Clinical canonical variates
  
  rownames(clinical_variate) <- colnames(clinical_final)
  
  clinical_metabolite_canonical_variates = clinical_variate %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(clinical_variables = rownames(clinical_variate)) %>%
    dplyr::rename("metabolite canonical variate 1" = V1,
           "metabolite canonical variate 2" = V2,
           "metabolite canonical variate 3" = V3) %>%
    relocate(clinical_variables, .before = "metabolite canonical variate 1")
  
  clinical_metabolite_canonical_variates_filtered <- clinical_metabolite_canonical_variates %>%
    filter(`metabolite canonical variate 1` != 0 | 
             `metabolite canonical variate 2` != 0 | 
             `metabolite canonical variate 3` != 0)
  
  clinical_metabolite_canonical_variates_long <- clinical_metabolite_canonical_variates_filtered %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("metabolite canonical variate"),
                 names_to = "Canonical_Variate",
                 values_to = "Value")
  
  heatmap_data <- clinical_metabolite_canonical_variates_long %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Canonical_Variate, values_from = Value) %>%
    column_to_rownames(var = "clinical_variables")
  
  heatmap_data <- tibble::rownames_to_column(heatmap_data, var = "Variable")
  
  MoTrPAC_trait_annotation <- readxl::read_excel(trait_annotation_path)
  
  category_order <- c(
    "Fitness/Performance",
    "Strength",
    "Ventilatory response",
    "Blood pressure response",
    "Heart rate response",
    "Effort",
    "Body composition"
  )
  
  annotated_data <- heatmap_data %>%
    left_join(MoTrPAC_trait_annotation, by = "Variable") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Category = factor(Category, levels = category_order)) %>% # Set category order
    arrange(Category) %>% # Arrange rows by Category
    mutate(Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, `VO2max` = 'VO2max (ml/kg*min)')) %>%
    mutate(Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, `VO2max_L` = 'VO2max (L/min)')) %>%
    mutate(Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, `O2_pulse` = 'O2 pulse')) %>%
    mutate(Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, `wattend_cpet` = 'End Watts')) %>%
    mutate(Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, `avg_handgrip` = 'Handgrip Strength')) %>%
    mutate(Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, `peaktorqavg_iske` = 'Peak Torque')) %>%
    mutate(Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, `avg_vco2cart_cpet` = 'Avg VCO2')) %>%
    mutate(Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, `avg_vecart_cpet` = 'Avg VE')) %>%
    mutate(Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, `diaend_cpet` = 'DBP end')) %>%
    mutate(Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, `diarecv1_cpet` = 'DBP 1 min')) %>%
    mutate(Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, `sysend_cpet` = 'SBP end')) %>%
    mutate(Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, `sysrecv1_cpet` = 'SBP 1 min')) %>%
    mutate(Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, `hrend_cpet` = 'HR end')) %>%
    mutate(Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, `hrrecv1_cpet` = 'HR 1 min')) %>%
    mutate(Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, `avg_rercart_cpet` = 'Avg RER')) %>%
    mutate(Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, `wtkg_cpet` = 'Weight')) %>%
    mutate(Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, `bmi` = 'BMI'))%>%
    mutate(Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, `age` = 'Age'))
  
  annotated_data$Category <- factor(annotated_data$Category, levels = unique(annotated_data$Category))
  
  heatmap_matrix <- annotated_data %>%
    dplyr::select(-Variable, -field_name_description, -Category) %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  # heatmap_matrix <- as.matrix(annotated_data[, -c("Variable", "field_name_description", "Category")]) # Exclude Variable, Description, and Category columns
  rownames(heatmap_matrix) <- annotated_data$Variable
  
  # Create a color mapping for categories
  category_colors <- setNames(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = length(levels(annotated_data$Category)), "Set3"),
                              levels(annotated_data$Category))
  
  # Create row annotation with category colors
  row_annotation <- rowAnnotation(
    Category = annotated_data$Category,
    col = list(Category = category_colors),
    show_legend = TRUE
  )
  
  colnames(heatmap_matrix) <- c("CV1", "CV2", "CV3")
  
  
  mat = heatmap_matrix
  k <- 2
  drop_diag <- TRUE
  
  storage.mode(mat) <- "numeric"
  
  # Fallbacks if names are missing
  if (is.null(rownames(mat))) rownames(mat) <- paste0("r", seq_len(nrow(mat)))
  if (is.null(colnames(mat))) colnames(mat) <- paste0("c", seq_len(ncol(mat)))
  
  # Optional: drop diagonal for square same-named matrices
  if (drop_diag && nrow(mat) == ncol(mat) && all(rownames(mat) == colnames(mat))) {
    diag(mat) <- NA_real_
  }
  
  # ---- Top-k by |score| per row and per column (union) ----
  topk_idx <- function(x, k) {
    ok <- which(!is.na(x))
    if (!length(ok)) return(integer(0))
    ok[order(abs(x[ok]), decreasing = TRUE)][seq_len(min(k, length(ok)))]
  }
  
  row_edges <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(mat)), function(i) {
    j <- topk_idx(mat[i, ], k)
    if (!length(j)) return(NULL)
    data.frame(row = rownames(mat)[i], col = colnames(mat)[j], score = mat[i, j])
  }) |> bind_rows()
  
  col_edges <- lapply(seq_len(ncol(mat)), function(j) {
    i <- topk_idx(mat[, j], k)
    if (!length(i)) return(NULL)
    data.frame(row = rownames(mat)[i], col = colnames(mat)[j], score = mat[i, j])
  }) |> bind_rows()
  
  edges <- bind_rows(row_edges, col_edges) |>
    distinct(row, col, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  stopifnot(nrow(edges) > 0)
  
  # ---- Build bipartite graph ----
  row_nodes <- data.frame(name = sort(unique(edges$row)), type = TRUE,  group = "Row")
  col_nodes <- data.frame(name = sort(unique(edges$col)), type = FALSE, group = "Col")
  nodes <- bind_rows(row_nodes, col_nodes)
  
  g <- graph_from_data_frame(d = edges, vertices = nodes, directed = FALSE)
  
  # Edge attributes
  E(g)$score  <- edges$score
  E(g)$abs    <- abs(edges$score)
  E(g)$sign   <- ifelse(edges$score >= 0, "pos", "neg")
  
  # ---- Compact, Cytoscape-ish manual layout (two vertical rails) ----
  # Rows on x=0, columns on x=1; y evenly spaced within [0,1] to keep things tight
  rows <- which(V(g)$group == "Row")
  cols <- which(V(g)$group == "Col")
  
  y_rows <- if (length(rows) == 1) 0.5 else seq(0, 1, length.out = length(rows))
  y_cols <- if (length(cols) == 1) 0.5 else seq(0, 1, length.out = length(cols))
  
  layout_df <- data.frame(
    x = c(rep(0, length(rows)), rep(1, length(cols))),
    y = c(y_rows, y_cols)
  )
  layout_df <- layout_df[match(V(g)$name, c(row_nodes$name, col_nodes$name)), , drop = FALSE]
  
  # ---- Plot ----
  set.seed(1)
  p <- ggraph(g, layout = "manual", x = layout_df$x, y = layout_df$y) +
    # edges: color by score, width ∝ |score|
    geom_edge_link0(aes(edge_colour = score, edge_width = abs), alpha = 0.9, show.legend = TRUE) +
    scale_edge_colour_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0) +
    scale_edge_width(range = c(0.6, 3.2)) +
    # nodes
    # geom_node_point(aes(shape = group), size = 3) +
    geom_node_point(size = 3) +
    # labels: left side right-justified, right side left-justified, placed just outside
    geom_node_text(
      data = subset(as.data.frame(igraph::as_data_frame(g, what = "vertices")), group == "Row"),
      aes(x = layout_df$x[match(name, V(g)$name)]-0.03,
          y = layout_df$y[match(name, V(g)$name)],
          label = name),
      hjust = 1.05, vjust = 0.5, size = 7, fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    geom_node_text(
      data = subset(as.data.frame(igraph::as_data_frame(g, what = "vertices")), group == "Col"),
      aes(x = layout_df$x[match(name, V(g)$name)],
          y = layout_df$y[match(name, V(g)$name)],
          label = name),
      hjust = -0.10, vjust = 0.5, size = 7, fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.75, 1.15), ylim = c(-0.02, 1.02), expand = FALSE) +  # compact frame
    theme_graph() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
      plot.margin = unit(c(10, 10, 10, 10), "pt")
    ) +
    labs(
      edge_colour = "CCA score",
      edge_width  = "abs score"
    )
  
  # --- 9. Save to PDF ---
  cairo_pdf(pdf_output_path, width = 8, height = 10)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
  
}
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
plot_metabolite_clinical_bipartite_pdf(
  permutations = 1000,
  repo_local_dir = repo_local_dir,
  trait_annotation_path = file.path(data_dir, "MoTrPAC trait annotation.xlsx"),
  pdf_output_path = file.path(plot_dir,"Figure_4" ,"Figure_4A.pdf")
)
```
